svg.aria-label: SOMA overview: F answers the early turns; a soft prompt on the frozen surrogate G finds the turns where G is easiest to push away from F; a low-rank adapter is fitted on those turns; a gate hands the session to G, which serves from a compact context until a drift monitor rolls back to F.
svg.text: (block width = length of the user turn)
warm-start: F answers, and its replies are kept as targets
G serves from a compact context
Mine weak spots with a soft prompt
